name: Mistral Large 4
weights: open (Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight License, a modified MIT licence)
access: Mistral API and Mistral Studio (ids mistral-large-4 and mistral-large-4-0; public preview)
Hugging Face weights (Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B in FP8, published 2026-10-29; Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B-NVFP4 for Blackwell GPUs)
NVIDIA-hosted endpoints and a NIM container (per Mistral's launch post)
vLLM, SGLang, Transformers and llama.cpp GGUF files (per the model card)

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: List price on Mistral's model page and in the 2026-10-29 launch post; Artificial Analysis shows the same input and output prices. The changelog entry of 2026-10-06 gave a launch price 50% lower for two weeks. Batch requests are 50% cheaper per Mistral's pricing page (maker README)

sources.quote: Mistral Large 4 supports low, medium, and high reasoning effort.
Starting today, Mistral Large 4 is priced at $0.70 input / M, $0.07 cached input / M, and $2.10 output / M tokens.
49 billion active parameters per token (52 billion including embeddings and output layers)
must enter into a separate commercial license with Mistral before using the Model or its derivative works for any commercial purpose

unknown: max_output: no output cap separate from the context window is published on the model page or the model card
context_window: published as '1M'; the checkpoint's generation config allows 1,048,576 positions, and the API limit as an exact number is not stated
SWE-Bench Pro (Scale, public V2): no row for this model on Scale's leaderboard (read 2026-10-31)
METR 50% time horizon: no entry for this model on METR's time-horizons page (read 2026-10-31)
Terminal-Bench 4.0: no row for this model on the tbench.ai leaderboard (read 2026-10-31); the figures on this card are Artificial Analysis's runs
system_card: Mistral publishes no system card; the card field holds the Hugging Face model card, and the launch post says a technical report is coming
status: the docs page and the changelog say public preview; the launch post of 2026-10-29 calls the open-weight model an improved Mistral Large 4 and gives no new status
released: 2026-10-06 is the public-preview date on the docs page and in the changelog; the weights were published on 2026-10-29
API checkpoint: the docs page still shows version 26.10 and the date 2026-10-06; whether the API id now serves the improved checkpoint of 2026-10-29 is not stated
parameters: the model card gives about 1T total and 49B active (52B with embeddings and output layers); the docs page gives 1.05T total and 52B active
retires: the models page lists no retirement date
